Name: Custom Rainbow Emily Gift
Author: CheesyMashedPotatoes
Description: This mod replaces the outfit that Emily gives at her 14 heart event with a rainbow themed outfit. The boots are based on the cowboy boots with a rainbow stripe, the shirt can either be a black shirt or teal hoodie, both with added rainbow scarf, and the hat can either be a darker deluxe cowboy hat with a rainbow feather or a headband.
